name: structural-scanner-anchor-relocation
body: The bundled structural scanner (`rust.structfrontend`, binary `structfrontend`) lives in `src/structlib` and absorbs the `src/mdlib` Markdown frontend's role. Its durable anchors are: `solution.container.structural-scanner` implemented-by the Module `rust.structfrontend`; `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` implemented-by `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.structfrontend.main`, and `rust.structfrontend.run`; and `solution.component.structural-format-emitters` implemented-by `rust.structfrontend.walk`, `rust.structfrontend.line_count`, `rust.structfrontend.parse_headings`, and `rust.structfrontend.build_doc`. All eight anchors resolve in the branch graph.
